Audio Services

Crystal-Clear Audio for Every Space

State of the art speakers and microphones — professionally engineered for perfect sound in any venue, for groups of 20 or 2000.

Great presentations start with great sound. Whether you need crystal-clear audio for a boardroom briefing or powerful line-array speakers for a ballroom keynote, Lafayette Sound brings the right audio equipment and the expertise to tune it perfectly. Our engineers analyze your room, dial in the system to eliminate feedback and dead spots, and stay on-site throughout your event to keep everything sounding its best.

What's Included

  • Line-array PA and speaker systems for large venues
  • Wireless and wired speakers and microphones
  • Handheld, lapel, headset, and podium microphones
  • In-ear monitor systems for presenters
  • Digital mixing consoles and signal processing
  • Acoustic analysis and system tuning
  • Redundant audio signal paths
  • Hearing loop and ADA audio accessibility support
  • Post-event audio recording
